name: Amb_Forest_Thunder_Rain_Night_KA
description:
Rain and thunder in forest during a hot summer night. Birds are very active and creates a nice texture and depth to the environment. Makes me feel relaxed and would be a great storytelling device for a film or game.

Location: Sweden, Stockholm, Rissneängarna

Recorded on Zoom H5 XY Capsule

In Pro Tools Studio i barley touched the EQ, rolled a tiny bit of lows and tried to "tight" it together

Hope it comes to some use for you!
